chartProvenance.issuer: 株式会社横浜アリーナ (first-party facility operator)
chartProvenance.assetLinkedFrom: the A-pattern (Aパターン) page's own zoom link; the B and 中央 pages link img_seatzoom_02.png and img_seatzoom_03.png respectively

acquisitionAndMethod.acquisition: Direct HTTPS fetch of the A-pattern zoom chart asset from the issuer domain; no third-party or historical copy used.
visualMethod: Method chosen fresh for this session; no historical Yokohama structural or transcription report was consulted.
Straight blocks (A, D) and the top-centre straight stand section: direct high-DPI crops at 2.2-3x, read left-to-right per labelled row.
Wedge blocks (E, F): single rigid rotation (-19 deg for F, +19 deg for E) of the block region to bring rows horizontal, then per-row reads at 3-3.4x with row labels in frame.

Corner blocks (B, C): elliptical polar resampling about the bowl's left-end centre (image coords 1754,1950) with a constant 57px major/minor offset, sampled over 181..88 deg (B) and 179..272 deg (C, then vertically flipped for upright glyphs); row labels at both strip ends kept in frame; every column re-read a second time from an independent rigid-rotation view (B: +19/+40/+65/+90 deg sectors; C: -90 deg sector).

Outer stands (西, 北): elliptical polar resampling about the same centre over the stand radii, chunked into six overlapping windows read at 2.0-2.1x, plus dedicated 4-row band strips to classify landings.
Outer stands (東, 南): direct crops and a polar resampling about the right-end centre (3400,1950); row labels 1-10 in frame.

Glyph disambiguation and step/landing classification resolved by returning to the chart at 5-9x native-pixel zoom (a seat cell is a full-row-height narrow rectangle; a staircase is a vertically inset wider rectangle; a landing is a large unsubdivided rectangle).
prohibitionsObserved: No range completed from symmetry, from a neighbouring row, or to fit any capacity or subtotal.
No seat identifier generated from machine geometry; no OCR or machine extraction used as a seat-ID source.
Printed positional gaps recorded as gaps, never filled.
No mixing of the A pattern with the B or 中央 pattern.
Excluded categories not transcribed: 1階センター席 (event-variable arena floor), 立見スペース, スイート・ボックス (no printed row or seat identifier on the chart), STAGE area.
